the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: applies the Artin axioms openness criterion from an obstruction theory: conditions (1), (2), (3) of the criterion are the diagonal, RS-star, and limits lemmas for the coherent stack; the obstruction theory is O_x(M) = Ext^2_{X_A}(F, F x M) with obstruction class o(F, F x I, 1) from the deformation theory lemma, all axioms following from that lemma except functoriality which reduces (by the criterion's footnote) to functoriality for fixed A given by the functoriality lemma; the tangent identification T_x(M) = Ext^1 comes from the same lemma; finally the product conditions T_x(prod M_n) = prod T_x(M_n) and O_x(prod M_n) = prod O_x(M_n) follow from the perfect object K of the compute-ext lemma (i <= m = 2) together with the characterization of pseudo-coherent complexes by product-commutation of cohomology (source lines 1604-1663)
